chunks.text: Isla Capitán Aracena is an island of southern Magallanes. SBAP/SIMBIO recognizes it as a geoform of the marine ecosystems Cockburn Magdalena - Magallanes (ECOMAR-056) and Estrecho de Magallanes Central - Magallanes (ECOMAR-058).

The official basin Islas al Sur Estrecho de Magallanes includes a subbasin named Isla Capitan Aracena y adyacentes. This provides general spatial context but should not be used as a substitute for authoritative coastal geometry or navigation data.
